name: Palette Boracay Isle by The White Beach
detail: The air conditioning works well, the staff are friendly, early check-in is available, the refrigerator works well, and there is strong Wi-Fi. 👀👀

name: Fairways and Bluewater Boracay
detail: A hotel I always wanted to stay at because of its good location. The private beach had a lot of seaweed, which was different from my expectations, so I didn't go into the water. I also received an upgrade for the room, and the staff's service was excellent. The breakfast venue was lovely as well.

name: Boracay Ocean Club Resort and Spa
detail: Close to the beach, right in front, there are many restaurants nearby so there's no need to go all the way to the mall, surprisingly crowded, all the staff are friendly, breakfast is decent, room conditions are also okay, fridge is cool, the hotel's mart is cheaper than well-known marts. However, if you are sensitive to noise, the full-access room is not recommended.

name: Happiness Hostel Boracay
detail: I was pleasantly surprised when I first entered. It was so beautiful. I loved the atmosphere where everyone could talk freely, and I was charmed by all the amenities, including the various tables, the restaurant, rocking chairs, yoga seminar room, and pool. The dormitory room even had lockers, which I was very satisfied with. Personally, I found the air conditioning a bit too cold, so I had to wear extra clothes to sleep, but on the last day, I was able to adjust the air conditioning, which was even better. There were events every evening, but they weren't too loud and seemed cheerful. The East Blahok Beach and Gata Beach were not far from White Beach, so it was nice to walk around. Everything was so great that I will definitely visit again next time.

name: Paradise Garden Resort Hotel and Convention Center Boracay
detail: It was my second stay in a Superior Room with a week interval, and the reception staff checked me into a slightly larger room among the Superior Rooms, which I liked very much. There was a bit of noise from the air conditioning, but the room was spacious, so it was good. The room was located very close to the main pool, making it convenient to go to the pool. There were some Korean package tourists, and many travelers from the Philippines.

name: Frendz Hostel Boracay
detail: If you are looking for an affordable stay, this is the answer. Just don't expect with the facilities. One issue for me is the aircon. It can be too cold and too warm depends on who you with. Still, a value for money.

name: Calma Home
detail: I stayed at Calma Home from September 5–8, and the place was really nice for a chill and relaxing staycation. The pool was always clean, plus the sauna and ice bath were such nice additions. I stayed in the 4-Dorm Female Room, and the best part for me was the very comfy foam and the big, clean bathroom—which is a high priority for me. I was also alone in the room for the first 3 nights, and my roommate only arrived on my last day of stay. The staff were all nice and friendly. They also have a sunset café on the third floor where they serve limited food and drinks. It’s quite pricey, but masaaraaaap! 😂 They also have different activities for guests, but I only joined the Slow Yoga class with Heman. The class was almost two hours, and Heman was very patient with me since it was my first time doing yoga. He also adjusted some of the poses for beginners, which I really appreciated. It was such a nice experience that even after I got back home, I found myself doing some night yoga hehe. One thing I also liked is that it’s just around a 10-minute walk from White Beach, so it’s still convenient if you want to go to the beach. The only con for me is that the place is located quite high up, so there are a looooot of stairs. If you have big luggage like me, I’d recommend hiring a tricycle from the port to take you all the way up. Since it’s also a bit secluded, I usually went back to the accommodation around 5 PM, especially since I was traveling solo. Overall, Calma Home felt more like a real rest place for me rather than just an accommodation. Guests are welcome to sleep and relax whenever they want—on the couch, near the pool, at the café, basically wherever you feel comfortable. 😂 It was honestly a really nice place to slow down, rest, and just do nothing for a while. ❤️
area: Barangay Manoc-Manoc,Boracay Island - View on map

name: Feliz Hotel Boracay Managed by Enderun Hotels
detail: I believe staying at Feliz for my first accommodation on my first Boracay trip was the best choice. To list the advantages: 1. Undoubtedly the best location, right in the middle of D’Mall. 2. Even though it's in the middle of D’Mall, the rooms are completely quiet and well soundproofed. 3. Very friendly staff and perfect cleanliness. 4. A small but clean pool with a sunset view. 5. A different breakfast setup every day. I definitely plan to stay at Feliz again on my next Boracay trip.

name: Canyon Hotels & Resorts Boracay
detail: The hotel is next to Robinson Mall. The hotel is very clean and the staff is kind. It operates a free shuttle bus, so it's convenient to go to Station 2.

name: Mandarin Bay Resort & Spa
detail: Mandarin Bay: Best Value for Money I really struggled between Crystal Hotel and Mandarin Bay, but Mandarin Bay came out overwhelmingly on top! Its location next to the Regency Hotel is just perfect! There's a lovely walkway that leads directly from the pool to the beach! The pool is long and wide, making it perfect for playing with kids! The layout of the hotel is convenient, minimizing movement, and there are plenty of good restaurants nearby. There's live music every night in front of the pool, creating a great atmosphere! It was also perfect for enjoying a beer on the balcony and relaxing! Moreover, even though the check-in time is at 3 PM, they let us check in for free at 1 PM, and the front desk staff were really friendly! It’s much better than Crystal Hotel in every way! The only downside is that while Crystal Hotel offers breakfast tailored to Korean tastes, Mandarin Bay's menu is a bit lacking as it's geared more towards locals or Chinese tastes!
